description: This file defines two interfaces related to grain observation in Orleans. The ISimpleObserverableGrain interface extends ISimpleGrain and includes methods for subscribing, unsubscribing observers, and retrieving runtime instance ID. The ISimpleGrainObserver interface extends IGrainObserver and includes a method to notify when state has changed.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes an observer to receive notifications.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Retrieves the runtime instance ID of the grain.

methods.name: StateChanged
methods.description: Notifies observer of a change in state with two integer parameters.
